capabilities: Render and edit notes in vertical Japanese layout (tategaki)
Apply and remove Aozora notation annotations (ruby, tate-chu-yoko, emphasis marks, headings)
Auto-indent with full-width spaces and enforce kinsoku line-break rules
Search and replace text within the vertical view
Navigate heading annotations via an outline sidebar panel
extras: Installation is documented only from source (clone, build, copy to plugins folder). README lists known IME and annotation-boundary limitations, and several settings are marked experimental. A Japanese-language README is referenced but not included.
problem: Obsidian's editor only lays out text horizontally, so writing Japanese in the traditional vertical format is not possible in vanilla Obsidian.

relations.evidence: supports the annotation syntax used by Aozora Bunko, a digital library of Japanese literature

summary: Vertical writing mode that renders and edits Japanese notes top-to-bottom, right-to-left, with Aozora notation for ruby, headings and emphasis marks.
